captionLines: The People of the State of New York, Respondent,
dateLines: Appeal, by permission of a Justice of the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court in the First Judicial Department, from an order of that Court, entered May 9, 2023. The Appellate Division affirmed a judgment of the Supreme Court, New York County (Daniel P. FitzGerald, J.), which had convicted defendant, upon a jury verdict, of burglary in the third degree.
